title: Spider-Man (2000)/Controls
text:
Basic controls

Advanced controls

 Jumping Punch - Jump, Punch
 Jumping Kick - Jump, Kick
 Grab - Kick/Punch + Web
 Grab & Punch - Punch (while grabbing an enemy)
 Grab & Kick - Kick (while grabbing an enemy)
 Web Spikes - Web + 
 Web Dome - Web + 
 Break Web Dome - Punch/Kick (while in Web Dome)
 Impact Webbing - Web + 
 Web Yank - Web + 
 Web Yank Left - Web +  + 
 Web Yank Right - Web +   +
